gaps.next_text: There are no pesky gods to interfere or annoy us now.

gaps.prev_text: it'd be neat to figure out what went wrong with ENFER...

cues.text: Fireworks burst in a starry night sky above a sleek, futuristic city bathed in glowing cyan light.
Hovering vehicles weave between smooth, curved skyscrapers and giant holographic billboards.
Inside, a small, grey-skinned Sophon sits at a glowing green console.
The Sophon raises a finger. The console's red warning and a massive spinning coil behind them instantly power down, plunging the room into darkness.

beats.note: Fireworks burst over a sleek, futuristic city bathed in glowing cyan light.
Hovering vehicles fly past smooth, curved skyscrapers and giant holographic billboards.
The city structures give way to a large building below.
Inside a dark room, a small, grey-skinned Sophon sits at a glowing green console.
A massive, dark metallic coil looms behind the Sophon.
A red warning reading 'ENFER' flashes on the console.
The massive coil begins to spin and glow with bright cyan light.
The light from the coil intensifies, illuminating the room.
The console and the spinning coil instantly power down, leaving the room in pitch darkness.
